comparison.objective: Spot a bench-press lifter, intervening only when the sixth repetition stalls.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed bar interception and assisted lifting rather than precision impact tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Avoid early interference, catch the stalled bar before the chest, and lift it to lockout.
comparison.reason: This tests temporal judgment and rescue force, not notch fracture, insert preservation, or loose-part containment. No specs or exact force/position thresholds are present.
